title: Surface stack
description: Which modes and brand to draw the scheme's surfaces in: the canvas, then color.surface.default, then color.surface.sunken, one inside the other. The colors come from the scheme's tokens, not from this data. Drawn by the SurfaceStack composite on Foundations › Color.

brand.description: The brand's id in the tokens, when the scheme has more than one.

modes.description: The modes to draw, light first.
